labels.rationale: Manually audited at the pin: ApiKeysTable is a mobx observer and receives an inline page object. Each keystroke in the filter input sets query (line 32), which the table never reads, so every keystroke re-renders the whole table with equal data. data, sort and next come from useTableRequest and a router-derived memo, so their identity is not provable and the finding stays a candidate.

Manually audited at the pin: the same shape as ApiKeys. The query state (line 35) changes on every filter keystroke and re-renders the observer EmojisTable through its inline page object. The useTableRequest results and canManage are unproven, so it stays a candidate.

Manually audited at the pin: GroupMembersTable is an observer with an inline page object, and it re-renders for every filter keystroke through query (line 81). group comes from a MobX store lookup, and data, sort and next come from useTableRequest, so the finding stays a candidate.

Manually audited at the pin: the inner ActionContextProvider in the Scene actions receives a fresh value object and a fresh Button child, so each filter keystroke re-renders the provider and every action-context consumer below it. It is a real but small cost (one button). t from react-i18next is a package hook whose identity is not provable.
Manually audited at the pin: this has the same keystroke-driven re-render of the observer WebhookSubscriptionsTable through an inline page object as ApiKeys. The useTableRequest results are unproven.

Manually audited at the pin: AccountMenu is an observer whose children render prop is rebuilt on every Sidebar_ render. isCollapsing, offset, isHovering, isAnimating and hasPointerMoved never reach it, so each hover change, animation toggle, collapse and resize start re-renders the account menu. Per-move width changes arrive through MobX, which the rule does not model as a render trigger. t is the only unproven input.

Manually audited at the pin: the observer DocumentExplorer receives the inline copy function, so the two copying transitions per copy re-render the explorer tree. The render is real but rare. The same handler also calls the onSubmit prop, and items and t are unproven, so it stays a candidate.

Manually audited at the pin; unresolved. PaginatedEventList is memo with an inline empty element, and it renders for compareTo and showChanges. Both handlers also rewrite the location through updateLocation, which can change the router-derived items, fetch and document in the same transition, so whether any render is avoidable is not established.
